headlines.title_zh: OpenRouter因数据违规移除三家AI供应商
headlines.title_en: OpenRouter removes Together AI, Phala, and Novita over data policy violations; Novita says a misconfiguration sent some MiniMax requests to MiniMax official API (Bill Toulas/BleepingComputer)
headlines.author: BleepingComputer
headlines.event_summary_zh: OpenRouter平台移除Together AI、Phala与Novita，理由是其违反隐私政策将用户请求转发至第三方API
headlines.event_summary_en: OpenRouter has removed Together AI, Phala, and Novita from its platform due to data policy violations. Novita acknowledged that a technical misconfiguration caused certain user requests intended for their service to be inadvertently routed to the official MiniMax API endpoints.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】OpenRouter（聚合平台）、Together AI、Phala、Novita（AI计算供应商）在OpenRouter平台API生态系统：移除供应商接口权限，因违规处理用户请求数据
【起因与机理】数据隐私保护策略受损及技术链路配置失误
【调查与监管诉求】OpenRouter因数据合规性违规清理供应商名录。
【各方立场与态度】AI平台需进一步强化对API生态中转路由的审计机制。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] OpenRouter, Together AI, Phala, Novita (OpenRouter API ecosystem): Removal of service providers due to data policy breaches
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Privacy protocol violations and internal configuration errors
[Key Fact Detail] OpenRouter removes providers for data compliance violations.
[Key Position & Outlook] Platforms must strengthen audit mechanisms for intermediary API traffic.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此事件暴露了聚合式AI服务架构在分布式推理路由中的透明度痛点，数据流经多重第三方中转极易触发合规边界模糊。对于以调用量为核心的商业模式而言，API路由链路的确定性与数据留存审计已成为企业级客户评估AI基建安全性的核心指标。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This incident highlights the inherent transparency risks in distributed AI inference routing, where multi-layer third-party handoffs complicate data governance. For high-volume API business models, deterministic routing and robust data retention audits are now critical prerequisites for enterprise-grade AI infrastructure.

celebrity.author: Yann LeCun
celebrity.author_role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
celebrity.quote_zh:
@FutureJurvetson @elonmusk @kimmonismus 背景：
“在过去 20 年的大部分时间里，我一直在尝试训练模型进行视频预测，但在前 15 年基本上失败了。直到我意识到必须放弃生成模型并使用联合嵌入预测架构 (JEPA)”

“过去几年，JEPA 和世界模型开始发挥作用。主要应用是物理世界、机器人和工业过程控制。Meta 对这些东西不是特别感兴趣”

但我的项目始终得到扎克、博兹、施雷普和克里斯·考克斯的支持。

确实，作为首席人工智能科学家，我虽然是高级副总裁级别，但却是一名 IC。公司最好的工作！

我从未攻读过法学硕士，这也是事实。我非常支持 FAIR 的 LLM 项目（例如后来成为 Llama 的项目），并在说服 Mark 围绕 Llama 创建人工智能优先产品部门方面发挥了作用，并推动开源 Llama-2。但我从来没有参与过技术层面的工作。
celebrity.quote_en:
@FutureJurvetson @elonmusk @kimmonismus Context:
"I've tried to train models to do video prediction for the better part of the last 20 years, and largely failing for the first 15. Until I realized you had to abandon generative models and use joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPA)" 

"Things started to work in the last few years with JEPA and world models. The main applications are in the physical world, robotics, and industrial process control. Things that Meta is not particularly interested in" 

But my project always had the support of Zuck, Boz, Schrep, and Chris Cox. 

It's true that, as Chief AI Scientist, I was at senior VP level but was an IC. Best job in the company! 

Also true that I never worked on LLMs. I was very supportive of LLM projects at FAIR (e.g. the project that became Llama), and played a role on convincing Mark to create an AI-first product division around Llama, and pushed to open source Llama-2. But I was never involved at the technical level.
celebrity.thesis_zh: 深入探讨世界模型与自监督的关键演进，直指核心工程落地与技术范式转移。
celebrity.thesis_en: Dissecting crucial inflection points in World Models & SSL, highlighting system trade-offs and engineering shifts.

celebrity.debate_en: Global developer community actively debates the broader industry implications.
